issues.legal_issue: A municipal authority may amend a finalized assessment list after the relevant assessment year has begun and apply the amended assessment to that year when the governing scheme permits later amendments and the property was eligible but mistakenly omitted.
material_facts: A building was completed and occupied before the assessment year for which it was to be assessed.
The building was omitted from the assessment list for that year, although it ought to have been included.
After the list had been finalized, the municipal authority notified the owner of a proposed amendment, considered the owner’s objection, and added the building to the list for that year.
issues.conclusion: The municipal authority was entitled to amend the assessment list after it had been finalized and to assess the building for the year to which the list applied; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 66 and 67 of the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911, read together, permit an assessment list to be amended after finalization: section 66 makes the list subject to amendments duly made thereafter, and section 67 authorizes amendment at any time on the grounds specified there. The meaning of “at any time” depends on context. The Court considered Central Bank of India Ltd. v. Hartford Fire Insurance Co. Ltd., AIR 1965 SC 1288, and Ex parte Norris, In re Salder, 17 Q.B.D. 728, in addressing that contextual interpretation.

rule.if: municipal_tax_assessment_challenge and property_ought_to_be_listed and property_omitted_through_mistake and amendment_made_after_list_finalization and later_amendment_authorized_without_deadline and affected_owner_given_notice_and_hearing

predicates.municipal_tax_assessment_challenge: An owner challenged a municipal authority’s addition of property to an assessment list for property taxation.
predicates.property_ought_to_be_listed: The property met the requirements for inclusion in the assessment list for the relevant taxation year.
predicates.property_omitted_through_mistake: The property was left out of the assessment list through a mistake.
predicates.amendment_made_after_list_finalization: The municipal authority amended the assessment list after it had been finalized.
predicates.later_amendment_authorized_without_deadl: The governing scheme allowed the municipal authority to amend the list later without requiring the amendment to occur before the assessment year began.
predicates.affected_owner_given_notice_and_hearing: The municipal authority notified the affected owner of the proposed amendment and allowed the owner to object and be heard.
predicates.later_amendment_can_support_tax_for_asse: A later amendment may support taxing the property for the assessment year covered by the list.

issues.definition: When an owner challenges a municipal tax assessment, the property was eligible but mistakenly omitted, the list is amended after finalization under a scheme allowing later amendment, and the affected owner receives notice and an opportunity to be heard, the amendment may support tax for the assessment year covered by the list.
